<b>Skarrgards</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Bulky defenders of the [[Skarr]]'s stores and passages, they attack with ferocious might.<ref>Skarrgard [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Huge ant hunter tasked to protect the stores and passages of its tribe. Theirs is the perfect shell for their duty, a wall of a warrior and an adept fighter."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skarrgards do not naturally wander, and are instead always resting in place. They often perform short forward dashes to pursue [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], but otherwise use Leaping Slam or Burrow to chase her down.<br>
Skarrgards have three different moves that they can perform:
* <b>Double Swing:</b> Rears back and performs two forward swings with their weapon, stepping backwards slightly on the second swing.
* <b>Jump Slam:</b> Leaps forwards to where Hornet is and performs a colossal overhead swing. Running under their jump is often the only means of escape without [[Swift Step]], but with a quick enough reaction, Hornet can also escape by running away.
* <b>Burrow:</b> Jumps down into the ground and reappears where Hornet is standing, with a slight variation. 

Skarrgards deal {{Damage|2}} for all attacks as well as contact damage.

As the fight starts, Skarrgards roar for approximately one second, during which they are vulnerable to damage. When a Skarrgard leaps for a jump slam, stay on the ground and walk past so that they pass overhead. Hornet can jump over a Skarrgard's Double Swings, following up with a downward attack to deal damage. Obtaining [[Swift Step]] is highly recommended, as it allows Hornet to dash and sprint, which greatly helps with evading Skarrgards' attacks. Alternatively, all attacks can be parried with good timing.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Skarrgards have their health doubled. They gain the [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void Blobs]] attack.

== Location ==
There are a total of four Skarrgards that can be found, and once defeated, they do not respawn:
* The first can be found guarding the passage between [[the Marrow]] and [[Hunter's March]].
* The second guards a storeroom at the top of Hunter's March, and takes part in the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Hunter's March 2|enemy gauntlet]] alongside a [[Spear Skarr]].
* The third appears in the [[Halfway Home]]'s cellar, as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 4|gauntlet]].
* The fourth, [[black-threaded]] Skarrgard can be found in [[Act 3]], in a hidden room past [[Skarrsinger Karmelita]]'s chamber in the [[Far Fields]].
